about_the_game:
Official Soundtrack for the Indie Game Twelves:Shadow

Featuring 14 immersive background tracks and 1 closing vocal piece, "Senza Parole”. Experience the mythic Eastern narratives and emotional depth of Twelves:Shadow through high-quality compositions.

rack List:

01 – Nameless – First Step

02 – The Hour of Ox – Unchanged

03 – The Hour of Tiger – Raging Eyes

04 – The Hour of Rabbit – Untainted

05 – The Hour of Long – Thunder’s Crown

06 – The Hour of Snake – Whispers in Wind

07 – The Hour of Horse – Born to Fight

08 – The Hour of Goat – The Question

09 – The Hour of Monkey – Drunken Truths

10 – The Hour of Rooster – Delirium

11 – The Hour of Dog – Passing Oath

12 – The Hour of Boar – Mother’s Umbrella

13 – The Hour of Rat – The Final Ascent

14 – Time’s Flow

15 – Senza Parole

About the Creators:

All music composed and produced by Sun Yuzhou.

Vocals for "Senza Parole" by Xiao Wu.
